I Understand Home Research Clinical Trials Clinical Trials .entry-header --> Clinical Trials The medical and surgical diagnostic tests and treatments of animals are similar to those in human medicine. In order to advance knowledge, researchers and clinicians at the College of Veterinary Medicine perform studies that investigate new diagnostics and treatments. These discoveries can often be applied to medicine across all species. Most clinical trials are based on preliminary laboratory research data that indicate that the new approach is better than what is already available.
